test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Dree festival in India is celebrated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• “Dree Festival” is a famous crop harvest festival, observed in Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• ​ “Dree Festival” is basically a crop harvest festival.
